steps.content: Donald slowly descends into a misty, surreal illusion.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Leader, we're all counting on you.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: You hit Nirvana hard last time, proving what the Inner Bay workers are made of. We've still got the power, haven't we?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: We're in a position to talk terms with them, right?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Help me... You're the strongest, get us out of here...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Help me... I'm terrified. I can't die now; I've got family. Please, do something...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Wasn't it you who said... with you around, nothing would go wrong?

steps.speaker: Inner Bay Worker
steps.content: Damn. Got a 100,000-volt shocker to show off? Sounds way tougher than those Sinners from the gang.

steps.speaker: Inner Bay Worker
steps.content: Took out those thugs single-handedly, huh? Quite the feat! Looks like you've just volunteered for this week's patrol duty, "Mr. Hero." And don't worry, I'll have your back when Margaret comes swinging.

steps.speaker: Inner Bay Worker
steps.content: Haha, you should've seen the look on those Nirvana faces! They turned ashen when they witnessed Doni's abilities!

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Emm! With power like this, we're sure to turn a lot of things around.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: So this is the Black Ring's trickery... Long time, no see...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Enough of this... These nightmares are old news to me... I escaped your clutches years back, and I can do it again now...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You can't fool me. I'm the only one here this time, and I won't allow you... I won't let you harm them again... Not on my watch...
Donald's head reels from a hit. Blinking away the shock, he looks up to find a familiar shape standing before him.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Back with us? You're unusually affected by the Black Ring, it seems.
